aws.agentcore.registry.records.note: $0.40 per 1,000 records a month. Free: the first 5,000 records every month, not time-limited (https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/agentcore/pricing/, Agent Registry: "First 5,000 records free monthly"); the page does not say the scope, so it is counted over the account like the AWS Free Tier (https://aws.amazon.com/free/free-tier-faqs/). Read by hand from the AgentCore pricing page (source); the AmazonBedrockAgentCore Price List has no usage type for it in any region, so sync cannot check it and regional prices are not published
